line: Praise someone's work in front of their boss.
paragraph: Nicole and Gary Wordsworth spent fifteen years designing electronics from home in Buckinghamshire. In spare hours, they took in dogs from Battersea Dogs Home, the animal shelter nearby. The count is now fifty-nine pups fostered, and both are in their sixties and retired. They never moved to full-time dogs, only kept the rhythm of part-time guests. Their reason stays plain: they love to get the animals out of the kennels. There is no talk of stopping.
